newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Nissho Iwai unit sets yen bond due 2003.
newsitem.headline: Nissho Iwai unit sets yen bond due 2003.

text.p: The following step-up callable fixed rate note issue has been privately placed, said arranger DKB Asia on Friday.

NEG PLG YES
CRS DEF YES FORCE MAJ YES
GOV LAW ENGLISH HOME CTRY JAPAN PAY DATE 20.DEC.96

ARRANGERS DKB ASIA
NOTES *NOTE PAYS A COUPON OF 2.00 PCT SEMI-ANNUALLY FOR THE
FIRST THREE-YEAR AND 2.30 PCT SEMI-ANNUALLY

**CALL OPTION ON EACH INTEREST PAYMENT DATE COMMENCING
THE ISSUE IS SENIOR, UNSECURED, UNSUBORDINATED AND HAS
A KEEPWELL AGREEMENT FROM NISSHO IWAI CORP. IT IS
LAUNCHED OFF THE BORROWER'S ASIAN DRAGON MEDIUM TERM
NOTE PROGRAMME SERIES 46.
COMMON CODE 7194218, ISIN XS007194218-8.
